input: Take a paternity leave planning meeting with HR

gold.taskTitle: Plan and Hold Paternity Leave Meeting with HR
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to schedule and conduct a paternity leave planning meeting with their HR department.

questions.title: When is your baby's expected arrival date?
questions.description: Understanding the due date helps determine the urgency and timeline for scheduling the HR meeting and leave.

questions.title: How many weeks of paternity leave are you considering?
questions.description: Knowing the intended leave duration helps identify what policies and entitlements need to be discussed with HR.

questions.title: Have you already contacted HR or is this first outreach?
questions.description: Determines whether the next step is initiating contact or preparing for an already scheduled meeting.

questions.title: What specific topics do you need HR to address?
questions.description: For example: pay during leave, job protection, benefit continuation, or return-to-work options.

questions.title: Does your company have a formal paternity leave policy?
questions.description: Knowing if a policy exists helps determine whether to research entitlements in advance or go in with open questions.

questions.title: What is your target date to have this meeting completed?
questions.description: A deadline helps prioritize scheduling and preparation steps appropriately.

questions.title: Will your direct manager need to be looped in before or after?
questions.description: Understanding whether manager communication is a prerequisite or follow-up step affects the order of actions.
